units.source_text: 至今我还可以清晰地回忆起来。

en.t: Even now, I can still recall it clearly.

units.source_text: 两个少年打着绑腿，身穿白衬衫，并肩站在镜湖畔。

en.t: Two boys, wearing gaiters and white shirts, stood side by side on the shore of Mirror Lake.

units.source_text: 两人的前方便是金阁的存在，中间没有任何东西阻隔。

en.t: Directly before them stood the Golden Pavilion, with nothing at all between them and it.
